He also represents [[Spain men's national basketball team|Spain]] in international competitions. ==Early life== De Larrea was born on 4 December 2005 in [[Valladolid]], Spain.{{Cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Sergio-De-Larrea/Summary/175825|publisher=[[RealGM]]|title=Sergio De Larrea}} His parents both played [[basketball]], with his father being a member of Club Deportivo Universitario and his mother playing for the team at the [[University of Valladolid]].{{Cite news|url=https://elpais.com/deportes/baloncesto/2024-12-15/sergio-de-larrea-el-espartano-que-ha-roto-el-molde.html|newspaper=[[El País]]|language=Spanish|title=Sergio de Larrea, el espartano que ha roto el molde|trans-title=Sergio de Larrea, the Spartan who has broken the mold|date=15 December 2024|author=Miñana, Fernando}} He grew up playing basketball and attended [[Colegio San Agustín (Spain)|Colegio San Agustín]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.elnortedecastilla.es/deportes/baloncesto/ofertas-tentadoras-estados-unidos-debo-cegarme-dinero-20240910105645-nt.html|newspaper=[[El Norte de Castilla]]|language=Spanish|title=El vallisoletano Sergio de Larrea posa en la pista central de L'Alqueria. |trans-title=Valladolid native Sergio de Larrea poses on the center court at L'Alqueria.|author=Luis Bort, José|date=10 September 2024}} After playing for a time with the team at his school, he left to join the club [[Valencia Basket]], training with their youth team.{{Cite news|url=https://www.diariodevalladolid.es/deportes/241225/266390/sergio-larrea-vallisoletano-cabeza-nba.html|newspaper=[[Diario de Valladolid]]|language=Spanish|title=Sergio de Larrea, un vallisoletano en la cabeza de la NBA|trans-title=Sergio de Larrea, a Valladolid native at the head of the NBA|author=Velasco, Guillermo|date=25 December 2024}} ==Professional career== De Larrea averaged 8.0 points for the Valencia U18 team in the 2020–21 season, then averaged 18.0 points for the Valencia reserve team in the [[Segunda FEB|Segunda LEB]] (third-tier) in 2021–22. He played most of the 2022–23 season with {{ill|CB L'Horta Godella|es}} in the LEB league, averaging 10.1 points. He was promoted and made his senior debut for Valencia in January 2023, in [[EuroLeague]] play, at the age of 17.{{Cite web|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/eurocup/news/top-10-eurocup-rising-star-award-candidates/|publisher=[[EuroLeague]]|title=Top 10 EuroCup Rising Star Award candidates|author=Sachs, Frankie|date=20 September 2024}} He returned to L'Horta Godella in 2023–24 and averaged 13.7 points, while also appearing in two games for Valencia.{{Cite news|url=https://as.com/baloncesto/mas_baloncesto/sergio-de-larrea-otra-joya-del-baloncesto-espanol-n/|newspaper=[[Diario AS]]|language=Spanish|title=Sergio de Larrea, otra joya del baloncesto español|trans-title=Sergio de Larrea, another gem of Spanish basketball|date=27 June 2024|author=Rubio, Juanma}} After declining offers to play [[college basketball]] in the U.S., he returned to Valencia for the 2024–25 season and played regularly for the team at [[point guard]]. ==International career== De Larrea helped Spain win a silver medal at the [[2022 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.marca.com/baloncesto/seleccion/2024/06/28/667f075022601da95a8b45ff.html|newspaper=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|language=Spanish|title=Sergio De Larrea, la última perla del baloncesto español, causa sensación|trans-title=Sergio De Larrea, the latest gem of Spanish basketball, causes a sensation|author=Luis Martínez, José|date=28 June 2024}} The following year, he helped Spain win the [[2023 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]], and in 2024, he competed at the [[2024 FIBA U20 EuroBasket|European U20 championship]]. He was called up to the [[Spain men's national basketball team|senior national team]] and trained with them prior to the [[2024 Summer Olympics]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.valenciabasket.com/?p=noticias¬icia=10994&lang=en|publisher=[[Valencia Basket]]|title=Sergio De Larrea joins the Valencia Basket first men's team |date=5 July 2024}} He made his senior national debut against the [[Dominican Republic men's national basketball team|Dominican Republic]] in June 2024. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Valencia BC current roster}} {{Supercopa de España de Baloncesto MVP Award}} {{DEFAULTSORT:de Larrea, Sergio}} [[Category:2005 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Valladolid]] [[Category:Spanish men's basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Valencia Basket players]]
